title: Uniform low energy resolvent for fibered-boundary Hodge Laplacians with compatible split models, positive remainders and composition on the resolved parameter space
difficulty_reason: After old2103 two-sided split phi-parametrix and named b/phi/scattering low-energy and pushforward tools are allowed, the author still arranges one parameter double space supporting both the harmonic scattering and perpendicular fully elliptic models, proves the required blowdown/lifting and two-density compatibility, and matches the zero-face finite-rank inverse model with the front-face block models while retaining strictly positive remainders at all intersections (2449-2478,2521-2537,2860-2914,3000-3300). Iterating that remainder further requires the concrete triple-space centers, lifted b-fibrations, full face-preimage data and split index closure (3423-3910); a general composition theorem does not supply those source-specific choices. Coordinating these geometric and analytic obligations supports one H3 uniform-resolvent framework. The projection identity, elementary tropical matrix algebra, old block construction and final Neumann closure are supporting parts of this same unit, not separate counted hard results.

New Theorems7.5/7.11 retain all Assumptions1.2-1.6, including spec_b(P00) disjoint[-1,1]. Do not replace that spectral interval condition by no-zero-resonance alone. Old2103's own nonindicial weight and standing conditions are preserved, not tightened by silently importing new1.4.

Keep fiberwise H=ker DeltaF and perpendicular C blocks, correct projections, W unitary transformation from geometric dvol_phi to b-volume L2 and split Sobolev/index conventions, and both front-face half-density powers -(b+1)/2.

The family is defined for real k>0; construction and uniform asymptotics concern k->0. Author3364 extends membership from small k to all positive k by full ellipticity/smooth dependence; no k->infinity uniform estimate is claimed. The complex half-plane/sector extension remains originalRemark1.8.
